title: MLEADERSTYLE DXF scalar fields reject duplicate occurrences
mode: P2 local source-schema correctness slice with generated ASCII/Binary controls
scope: Refuse repeated occurrences of all 48 represented singleton MLEADERSTYLE scalar, identity, color, handle and enum fields before publishing the typed object.
Leave reactor application groups and XDATA containers outside the singleton set so their repeated structure remains supported.
Exercise all 48 duplicate codes in ASCII and Binary DXF and verify a corrected source through the same dx_iface.

sources.title: Autodesk MLEADERSTYLE DXF reference
sources.supports: Defines the MLEADERSTYLE field map for the scalar groups handled by the parser. The reference marks repeated structures where they exist in related DXF schemas; these MLEADERSTYLE fields are individual values and the local model has one value slot per code. The duplicate rejection is a local source-schema integrity rule, not an external producer claim.

evidence.sourceCreation: The test generates a rooted AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE source locally with every represented field populated, duplicates one field at a time, and transcodes authored ASCII input to Binary DXF for binary controls. Scratch drawings are deleted after the test.

implementation.summary: processMLeaderStyle now owns its record loop and uses a local fixed-size seen-code set for the 48 scalar fields before raw capture and typed parsing. Repeated groups fail with BAD_CODE_PARSED before callbacks; non-singleton application/reactor/XDATA groups continue through the existing capture/parser path.
behaviorChanges: Duplicate style fields no longer silently overwrite earlier values or produce mismatched raw-versus-typed state.
Duplicate rejection occurs before typed object publication and before the duplicated field is added to the retained raw body.
A corrected valid object imports through the same reader after all malformed attempts.

results.focusedCTest: PASS 6/6 in 2.58 seconds; 96 generated duplicate-field cases were rejected and the same-reader valid retry passed.

limitations: The singleton list covers the currently modeled scalar groups; it does not assert completeness of the MLEADERSTYLE schema or validate every producer extension.
Remaining handle target roles, absent/default/version rules, and native annotation meaning remain open.
No whole-document, platform, ABI, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, native-producer or rendered-semantics claim is promoted.
